AccountId.description: ID of the AWS account the stack is deployed to. Terraform refuses to run against any other account.

AlbHostRouting.description: Expose the app through the environment's shared load balancer. `Subdomain` serves it at `https://<AppName>.<Environment>.oslo.systems`, `ApexDomain` at `https://<AppName>.oslo.kommune.no`. `Internal` uses the environment's internal load balancer instead of the public one. `TargetGroupTargetStickiness` keeps a visitor on the same container for 24 hours, using a load balancer cookie.

AppEcsExec.description: Let you open an interactive shell in the running container with the AWS CLI (Amazon ECS Exec).

AppName.description: Application name. Used to name the ECS service and related resources.

AppReadOnlyRootFileSystem.description: Make the container's root filesystem read-only, so the app can only write to mounted volumes.

AwsProviderVersion.description: Version constraint for the `hashicorp/aws` Terraform provider.

DailyShutdown.description: Stop the app every day at 16:00 UTC and start it again at 06:00 UTC. Saves money in environments that aren't used outside working hours, and follows the Green Software Foundation pattern [Scale down applications when not in use](https://patterns.greensoftware.foundation/operations/capacity-management/scale-down-unused-applications/).

DatabaseConnectivity.description: Give the app network access to the environment's database (created by the `databases` template), and inject the database endpoint into the container as the `DB_ENDPOINT` environment variable. Does not create a database.

DeploymentCircuitBreaker.description: Stop a deployment if the new version repeatedly fails to start or become healthy, and roll back to the last working version.

DeploymentPipelineV2.description: Deploy the app with the next-generation deployment pipeline. Replaces `IamForCicd` and `Ecr`.

Ecr.description: Deprecated: use `DeploymentPipelineV2` instead. Pulls the container image from the app's ECR repository (created by the `app-data` template). If disabled, set `image_uri` in `config_override.tf`.

Environment.description: Environment name (for example `dev` or `prod`), applied as the `Environment` tag on every resource in the stack.

ExampleImage.description: Run a public Nginx example image instead of your own application image. Useful for verifying that the infrastructure works before your own image and deployment pipeline exist. Cannot be combined with `DeploymentPipelineV2`.

IamForCicd.description: Deprecated: use `DeploymentPipelineV2` instead. Creates IAM roles for GitHub Actions: one for pushing images from the app repository (`AppGitHubRepo`), one for running Terraform from the IaC repository (`IacGitHubRepo`). `EcsDeployFromAppRepo` also lets the app repository trigger deployments. `AssumableCdRole` adds a role for debugging deployment permissions.

IncludeLockFile.description: Include a Terraform dependency lock file (`.terraform.lock.hcl`) that pins provider versions.

OpenTelemetrySidecar.description: Deprecated: use `TelemetryCollection` instead. Adds a sidecar that scrapes the app's Prometheus metrics from `/metrics` and sends them, along with container metrics, to the environment's Amazon Managed Prometheus workspace.

Region.description: AWS region the stack's resources are created in.

S3Backend.description: Store Terraform state in the environment's S3 state bucket, with state locking. Requires the `remote-state` template to have created the bucket; does not create it. If disabled, state is stored locally.

ServiceConnect.description: Let this app and other Service Connect-enabled services in the ECS cluster reach each other at `http://<AppName>:<port>` (Amazon ECS Service Connect).

StackName.description: Name of the Terraform stack, normally the name of the stack's folder in the IaC repository. Determines where the stack's state is stored.

Team.description: Team name, applied as the `Team` tag on every resource in the stack.

TelemetryCollection.description: Send the app's logs, traces and metrics to Datadog. `AutoInstrumentation` instruments the app automatically at startup (currently Java only). `DatadogAgent` adds container-level monitoring.

TerraformVersion.description: Terraform version constraint, set as `required_version` for the stack.

Terragrunt.description: Generate a `terragrunt.hcl` so the stack can be run with Terragrunt instead of plain Terraform. This is an experimental feature and should not be used in production.

VpcEndpoints.description: Keep the app's outbound traffic inside the VPC by using the environment's VPC endpoints instead of the internet. Requires VPC endpoints in the `networking` stack; does not create them.

Xray.description: Deprecated: use `TelemetryCollection` instead. Sends traces to AWS X-Ray.
